name: facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/options/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.initialize_BaseOptions: initialize a BaseOptions instance with argparse arguments for pix2pixHD model training and testing
facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.parse_BaseOptions: parse command line arguments and save options to an opt.txt file in the experiment directory
facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.get_opt_BaseOptions: get parsed options with GPU ID parsing and device selection without saving to disk
facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.configure_generator_options: configure generator network options including filter count, downsampling layers, and residual blocks
facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.configure_data_options: configure data loading options including batch size, image dimensions, label channels, and dataset paths

facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.run_test_inference: run test inference on fashion images using TestOptions with --ntest and --how_many arguments
facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.parse_test_options: parse command line test options for fashion image generation using TestOptions.parse()
facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.export_onnx_model: export the fashion generation model to ONNX format using the --export_onnx argument
facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.run_trt_engine: run a serialized TensorRT engine for fashion image inference using the --engine argument
facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.swap_outfit_piece: swap an outfit piece between reference and condition images using --reference_idx --condition_idx --swap_piece

facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.parse_train_options: parse command line arguments to get training options for the GAN model with all defaults applied
facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.get_train_opt: get parsed training options without printing or saving them to disk using get_opt method
facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.configure_learning_rate: configure the initial learning rate and decay schedule for the Adam optimizer during training
facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.set_loss_weights: set loss function weights for feature matching, VGG perceptual, style, reconstruction, and KL divergence losses
facebookresearch_fashionplus/generation/.configure_discriminator: configure the number of discriminators, layer count, and filter size for the discriminator network
